issues: 面板内容是通用灰色占位卡（几条灰条），撑开之后没有可看的东西
画面上方打着调试标题「LINE UNFOLD PANEL」
面板只占画面 1/4 左右，构图空，主体没有分量
撑开节奏是 5f/9f 但线体与面板之间缺少过渡亮度，关机后直接黑场收尾
changes: look = ember 改琥珀荧光：暖黑底 + 单色琥珀，整个镜头只有一种发光色，像一台单色 CRT 遥测终端；面板叠 3px 扫描线、文字带荧光余辉
主体换成为镜头设计的地面站遥测面板「Cairn Orbital」（1180×620，占画宽 61%）：168px 高度读数计数到 412.6 km、速度 / 信号 46px 数据、星下点轨迹描出与卫星点缓行、过境进度条
入场：中心光点预热 → 6f expo-out 抽线（两端火花）→ 12f out-cubic 撑面，上下发光边全程白热、四角 FUI 角标过冲咬合 → 扫描带自上而下逐行点亮内容（过曝回落）
关机：整屏琥珀 screen 过曝一拍 → 7f ease-in 压扁成线（重新白热）→ 6f poly4-in 缩点 → 十字星芒闪灭 + 横向荧光残影衰减
结尾不留死黑：熄灭处浮出一行 32px 等宽字「END OF PASS · 14:22:07 UTC」作尾帧海报；时长 120f → 126f，hold 段卫星点、LIVE 点、进度条与 1.5% 推近让画面持续活着
issuesEn: The panel content was a generic grey placeholder card (a few grey bars), so there was nothing to see once it opened
A debug title, 'LINE UNFOLD PANEL', was printed at the top of the frame
The panel filled only about a quarter of the frame; the composition was empty and the subject had no weight
The 5f/9f rhythm existed but brightness never carried from the line into the panel, and the shot ended on a dead black frame after power-off
changesEn: Look = ember tuned to amber phosphor: warm black with one amber glow colour, like a monochrome CRT telemetry terminal; 3px scanlines over the panel and phosphor afterglow on text

The subject is a shot-designed ground-station telemetry panel, 'Cairn Orbital' (1180×620, 61% of frame width): a 168px altitude readout counting to 412.6 km, 46px velocity and signal values, a ground track that draws on with a slowly moving satellite, and a pass progress bar

Entry: centre dot warms up → 6f expo-out line pull with sparks at both ends → 12f out-cubic unfold with white-hot edges, FUI corner brackets biting in with overshoot → a scan band lights the content top to bottom (overexposed, then settling)
Power-off: one-beat amber screen overexposure → 7f ease-in collapse to a line (white-hot again) → 6f poly4-in shrink to a dot → star flare and a decaying horizontal phosphor ghost

No dead black ending: a 32px mono line, 'END OF PASS · 14:22:07 UTC', rises where the dot died as the end poster; 120f → 126f, with the satellite, LIVE dot, progress bar and a 1.5% push keeping the hold alive
